# VonAI

> VonAI builds practical AI workflows for owner-led professional services firms with 10 to 100 people. One AI workflow, live in 30 days, measured against how the firm works today. Based in Helsinki.

The offer: the client picks one workflow that takes up the team's time. VonAI maps it and records a day-0 baseline in week 1, builds and tests it in weeks 2 and 3 (in the firm's existing tools where possible), puts it into daily use in week 4, and delivers a results report after 30 days of daily use (day 60) using the same measures.

Typical workflows:
- Enquiry handling: replies to website, email and WhatsApp enquiries within minutes, saves contacts to the CRM and offers meeting times. Measured by time to first reply, enquiries left unanswered and meetings booked.
- Proposal and tender drafting: drafts a first version from tender documents, past proposals and templates for an expert to edit and sign off. Measured by hours per proposal, turnaround time and proposals sent per month.

Pricing: the build is a fixed price agreed before work starts, and a monthly fee that starts after the day-60 results report covers monitoring, fixes and small improvements. Monitoring and fixes until the report are included in the build price. The amount depends on the workflow and is quoted after a free 30-minute call. The workflow runs in accounts the client owns.
